verdict.rationale: Supermemory's official MCP server lets users "ask naturally," with the assistant choosing the right Supermemory tool without code or tool names. Search also accepts plain-language queries such as "where does Alex work?", and community reports of 60k+ daily MCP users show the natural-language path is widely used. Missing for 10: a first-party natural-language command interface that doesn't depend on an external MCP-compatible assistant, documentation of which operations (add, search, delete, spaces) are reachable by natural language, and independent hands-on corroboration of command accuracy.
